gameDescriptionHtml:
Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre during the 1990s, returns in the first ever digital release of the 1996 PC version.

Now celebrated in this special 30th Anniversary Edition, the game has been restored to deliver a must-see experience.

30th Anniversary Edition key improvements:

Relicensed Soundtrack – A fully relicensed soundtrack featuring Soundgarden, Paw, Hammerbox, Monster Magnet, Swervedriver, and Therapy?, with the ability to now play their songs during the racing gameplay.

Source Master FMVs – In 2022, the Source Master tapes were discovered in the EA physical media vault. These tapes have been digitized and meticulously re-edited frame-by-frame to restore the dozens of FMV scenes, and integrate them back into the game.

Upscaled FMVs – As an optional enhancement, the FMVs have been further elevated to sharper quality using the latest in video upscaling technology for the best Road Rash cinematics ever seen.

Gameplay Optimizations – Enhanced for modern systems, enjoy improved framerates up to 60 FPS, native controller support, windowed mode, cloud saves, and more

This 30th Anniversary Edition is the ultimate way to enjoy one of the most important franchises in gaming history.

Original Road Rash game description:
Road Rash, the most aggressive motorcycle racing game ever, explodes on your PC with hard-hitting, full-throttle action that’ll bring you to your freshly skinned knees. Dodge traffic, outrace cops, and thrash opponents on your way to winning the Cup and becoming the menace to society your mother always worried about.

Engage in lawless, no holds barred high speed motor cycle street racing through cities, canyons, and packs of vicious bikers!

Photo-realistic 3D graphics with texture-mapping, atmospheric effects and super fast frame rate

25 knee-scraping races: 5 levels of racing, each with 5 courses, means only the toughest rashers have a chance to win the Cup
